2608.24870.title: SPO++: Stream-Aligned Policy Optimization for Asynchronous Agentic RL
2608.24870.paper_summary: Group-relative reinforcement learning waits for sibling rollouts of the same prompt, which is costly for long and variable tool-use trajectories. Single-stream Policy Optimization (SPO) removes this dependency with a persistent prompt-level value estimate, but its recipe whitens one advantage per trajectory before optimizing a token-mean actor loss. We show that trajectory centering generally does not center the token-weighted quantity consumed by the actor, and fix the mismatch by standardizing terminal-outcome advantages under the action-token measure. We additionally organize prompt evidence by the policy event that generated it rather than learner receipt order. Across matched runs on ALFWorld at two model scales and on Math-TIR, SPO++ improves online learning efficiency over SPO. A paired ablation identifies action-token-measure normalization as the strongest tested component.
2608.24870.paper_summary_zh: 群體相對增強學習等待相同提示的兄弟回放，這對於長且變化多端的工具使用軌跡來說是昂貴的。單流策略優化（SPO）通過持久的提示級價值估計消除了這一依賴，但其配方在優化令牌均值演員損失之前會使每條軌跡的優勢變白。我們展示了軌跡中心化通常不會使演員消耗的令牌加權數量中心化，並通過在行動令牌度量下標準化終端結果優勢來修正這一不匹配。我們還根據產生提示證據的策略事件而不是學習者接收順序來組織提示證據。在 ALFWorld 的兩個模型規模和 Math-TIR 上的匹配運行中，SPO++ 提高了在線學習效率，相較於 SPO。一個配對消融實驗確定了行動令牌度量標準化是測試過的最強組件。
